propositions: The reconciler requires a configuration-driven backend selection mechanism that reads a backend key from ReconcilerConfig and returns the appropriate Backend instance via select_backend(config)

Backend selection must be implemented as an in-tree decorator-registry pattern populated by @register side-effects, with JiraBackend as the sole registered implementation, avoiding setuptools entry-points

The reconciler.backend config field must support static validation at config-load time via _as_choice() coercer (allowing only registered keys like 'jira') and runtime env override via REBAR_RECONCILER_BACKEND

The select_backend() function must lazily import adapters/__init__.py to populate the registry before lookup, avoiding circular imports and ensuring deterministic registration regardless of caller import order

No existing consumer (_load_acli, AcliClient construction sites, differ/apply modules) is rewired as part of this story; consumer integration is deferred to a separate story that coordinates all rewiring simultaneously

Test coverage must verify config validation rejects unknown backend keys, select_backend returns the correct Backend instance with equivalent JiraSettings resolution, registry registration is idempotent, and a test-registered FakeBackend can be dispatched to via select_backend
